notes.title: Patch 1.0.5
notes.content:
Hello all,

We just released a small update to fix some random issues and add the 'Mouse Invert Y' option.

Raul from RVL Games

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4

tags.bug: - Fixed the issue with player custom controls not being saved;
- Fixed an issue wich let player gout outside map bounds in Farm level;
- Removed some placeholders items from Basement which could be collected in inventory;

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3

tags.bug: - Fixed a major bug wich let the player receive more than 1 power unit when reading a single sign;
- Fixed a game-breaking bug that appears in the detective's office;
